ai.summary: The University of Kashmir has cut branches from century-old chestnut trees, following past incidents of tree damage, raising concerns about conservation practices and historical heritage.

facts.claim: The University of Kashmir has a history of doing damage to its own green heritage.
facts.quote: The University of Kashmir has a history of doing damage to its own green heritage.

facts.claim: The recent cutting of branches from century-old chestnut trees is not an isolated incident.
facts.quote: The recent cutting of branches from century-old chestnut trees is not an isolated incident.

facts.claim: It follows an earlier episode at Naseem Bagh in 2009 and 2010, when extensive pruning and cutting destroyed much of the garden’s iconic shade.
facts.quote: It follows an earlier episode at Naseem Bagh in 2009 and 2010, when extensive pruning and cutting destroyed much of the garden’s iconic shade.

facts.claim: The university defended that exercise as necessary to remove old and overgrown branches, but the damage went far beyond routine maintenance.
facts.quote: The university defended that exercise as necessary to remove old and overgrown branches, but the damage went far beyond routine maintenance.

facts.claim: Nearly 15 years later, the same disregard appears to have returned.
facts.quote: Nearly 15 years later, the same disregard appears to have returned.

facts.claim: This time, century-old chestnut trees on the university campus have suffered heavy branch cutting.
facts.quote: This time, century-old chestnut trees on the university campus have suffered heavy branch cutting.

facts.claim: The intervention of a civil society climate group limited the damage largely to two trees.
facts.quote: The intervention of a civil society climate group limited the damage largely to two trees.

facts.claim: The campus has undergone considerable construction over the past decade to accommodate modern academic needs.
facts.quote: The campus has undergone considerable construction over the past decade to accommodate modern academic needs.

facts.claim: Expansion is a legitimate institutional responsibility, but it should never come at the cost of indiscriminate damage to established greenery.
facts.quote: Expansion is a legitimate institutional responsibility, but it should never come at the cost of indiscriminate damage to established greenery.

facts.claim: The University of Kashmir is an educational institution with a distinctive historical landscape.
facts.quote: The University of Kashmir is an educational institution with a distinctive historical landscape.

facts.claim: Its old trees, gardens and shaded pathways are part of a heritage that belongs to generations of students and the wider community.
facts.quote: Its old trees, gardens and shaded pathways are part of a heritage that belongs to generations of students and the wider community.

facts.claim: The recent cutting of the iconic green tunnel at Amar Singh College points to the same problem.
facts.quote: The recent cutting of the iconic green tunnel at Amar Singh College points to the same problem.

facts.claim: Its administration defended the decision by citing the age of the trees.
facts.quote: Its administration defended the decision by citing the age of the trees.

facts.claim: Such justifications expose a troubling approach to conservation, in which the age of a tree becomes a reason for its removal rather than a reason for greater care.
facts.quote: Such justifications expose a troubling approach to conservation, in which the age of a tree becomes a reason for its removal rather than a reason for greater care.

facts.claim: Old trees need expert assessment and appropriate maintenance, rather than arbitrary cutting.
facts.quote: Old trees need expert assessment and appropriate maintenance, rather than arbitrary cutting.

facts.claim: These institutions are custodians of public assets.
facts.quote: These institutions are custodians of public assets.

facts.claim: Their administrations may change, but the historical and environmental value of their campuses goes well beyond individual tenures.
facts.quote: Their administrations may change, but the historical and environmental value of their campuses goes well beyond individual tenures.

facts.claim: The chestnut trees at Kashmir University, planted during Maharaja Hari Singh’s time, also hold historical significance.
facts.quote: The chestnut trees at Kashmir University, planted during Maharaja Hari Singh’s time, also hold historical significance.

facts.claim: The demand by his grandson to hold those responsible accountable should prompt a transparent inquiry into who authorised the cutting and what expert advice informed the decision.
facts.quote: The demand by his grandson to hold those responsible accountable should prompt a transparent inquiry into who authorised the cutting and what expert advice informed the decision.

facts.claim: Kashmir needs a clear conservation policy for its educational campuses.
facts.quote: Kashmir needs a clear conservation policy for its educational campuses.

facts.claim: It should protect heritage trees, green tunnels and established landscapes through independent assessments, expert supervision and strict rules governing pruning and removal.
facts.quote: It should protect heritage trees, green tunnels and established landscapes through independent assessments, expert supervision and strict rules governing pruning and removal.

facts.claim: Construction projects should also undergo proper scrutiny to prevent avoidable damage to existing greenery.
facts.quote: Construction projects should also undergo proper scrutiny to prevent avoidable damage to existing greenery.

facts.claim: Universities teach students about environmental protection and sustainability. Their own campuses should demonstrate those principles.
facts.quote: Universities teach students about environmental protection and sustainability. Their own campuses should demonstrate those principles.

facts.claim: Kashmir’s educational institutions must move beyond defending damage after it occurs and adopt a culture of conservation before it is too late.
facts.quote: Kashmir’s educational institutions must move beyond defending damage after it occurs and adopt a culture of conservation before it is too late.

facts.claim: Those responsible for the latest cutting should be held accountable, and the protection of the region’s living heritage must become a binding institutional responsibility.
facts.quote: Those responsible for the latest cutting should be held accountable, and the protection of the region’s living heritage must become a binding institutional responsibility.

ai.background_note: The University of Kashmir has a history of damaging its green heritage, including past incidents at Naseem Bagh in 2009-2010 and recent cutting of century-old chestnut trees, raising concerns about conservation practices and historical heritage.
